representation.name: Sequence toolbox capabilities fixed
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
echo 'tool	path' > capabilities.tsv
for t in minimap2 samtools seqkit sourmash mash kallisto salmon bowtie2 bwa wget curl python; do
  if which "$t" >/tmp/tool_path 2>/dev/null; then
    p=`cat /tmp/tool_path`
  else
    p=''
  fi
  printf '%s	%s\n' "$t" "$p" >> capabilities.tsv
done
